# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global short-form video platform offering business advertising solutions, creator tools, and comprehensive safety features for users and brands.

TikTok provides multiple services including TikTok for Business (with Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, and Business Center), TikTok Shop for e-commerce, and robust safety and privacy controls. The platform serves creators, advertisers, and general users with tools for content creation, brand marketing, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- In-Feed Ads
- Creator Marketplace
- Community Guidelines
- Ads Manager
- Business Center
- TikTok Shop
- Content Moderation
- Safety Controls
- Privacy Settings
- Brand Awareness Campaigns
- Influencer Collaboration
- User-Generated Content
- Creative Center
- Platform Safety

## Business & Advertising

- [Free TikTok Business Account | TikTok For Business](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en/apps/business-account): TikTok Business Account setup with analytics and creative tools

## Safety & Privacy

- [Our approach to safety](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-sg/our-approach-to-safety): TikTok safety principles, Community Guidelines, and privacy settings
- [Our approach to safety](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-us/our-approach-to-safety): TikTok safety principles, Community Guidelines, and privacy settings
- [Our approach to safety](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/our-approach-to-safety): TikTok safety principles, Community Guidelines, and privacy settings
- [Guardian's Guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en-us/guardians-guide): Parental guide for TikTok safety controls and youth protection features

## Brand Case Studies

- [Cetaphil | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/cetaphil-357): Cetaphil skincare brand affinity campaign in Canada using In-Feed Ads
- [Vessi | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/vessi-354): Vessi waterproof sneakers ROAS campaign with @kallmekris creator
- [Jollibee Philippines | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/jollibee-philippines-248): Jollibee Philippines hashtag challenge for youth engagement campaign
- [Oatsome | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/oatsome-230): Oatsome online sales campaign targeting young consumers in Germany
- [Yves Saint Laurent | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/yves-saint-laurent-221): YSL Black Opium perfume Christmas campaign with influencers
- [ActionAid | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/actionaid-207): ActionAid nonprofit awareness campaign for violence elimination day
- [funny-frisch | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/funny-frisch-196): funny-frisch German chip brand awareness and engagement campaign
- [Etude House | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/etude-house-thailand-192): Etude House K-beauty e-commerce campaign in Thailand market
